qualities.label: Hardness
qualities.hint: Lauric + myristic + palmitic + stearic — coconut, palm, tallow, lard, cocoa & stearic butters. Below ~29 the bar stays soft; above ~54 it can get brittle and hard to cut.

qualities.label: Cleansing
qualities.hint: Lauric + myristic (coconut family). Above ~22 can strip skin; below ~12 may feel under-cleaning.

qualities.label: Conditioning
qualities.hint: Oleic + linoleic + linolenic + ricinoleic + palmitoleic — olive, avocado, macadamia, castor, soft oils. Above ~69 the bar softens and cures slower.

qualities.label: Bubbly lather
qualities.hint: Big fluffy bubbles come from lauric/myristic oils — coconut, palm kernel, babassu. Too high with low superfat = drying.

qualities.label: Creamy lather
qualities.hint: Palmitic + stearic + ricinoleic — palm, tallow, lard, butters, castor give dense, creamy suds.

qualities.label: Longevity
qualities.hint: Palmitic + stearic — palm, tallow, lard, cocoa/stearic butters. Low means the bar dissolves fast; high means a long-lasting, slow-wearing bar.

qualities.label: Mildness
qualities.hint: Oleic + linoleic + linolenic + ricinoleic + palmitoleic — olive, avocado, macadamia, soft oils, castor. Low can feel harsh; very high is gentle but softens the bar.

qualities.label: Iodine value
qualities.hint: Unsaturation → shelf life. Low = stable & hard; high = soft, faster rancidity (DOS). Keep high-iodine oils moderate and cure well.

qualities.label: INS
qualities.hint: Iodine × SAP combo — hardness & stability proxy. Below ~136 soft; above ~165 can be drying.
